title: Payment Gateway Integration Dubai | The Brandle
description: Payment gateway integration in Dubai. Stripe, Tabby, Tamara and card gateways connected to your store, plus delivery and accounting links, tested first.

hub.name: Payment integration
hub.line: Gateways, instalments and wallets, tested with real money.

hero.joke: The pay button is the one button on your site that has to work every single time.
hero.intro: Payment gateway integration in Dubai for stores and apps. Card gateways, instalment options like Tabby and Tamara, wallets, delivery APIs and accounting links, connected and tested end to end before a real customer touches them.

items.p: A gateway chosen for your licence, volumes and customers, then connected properly. We compare fees and payout times first.
Tabby, Tamara, Apple Pay and Google Pay added where your customers expect to see them.
Live rates, labels and tracking from carriers such as Aramex and DHL, where they offer an API for your account.
Orders and payments passed to systems like Zoho, QuickBooks or Odoo, so the books match the bank.
Payment confirmations handled so a paid order is always recorded, even when the customer closes the tab too early.
Every method tested in sandbox, then with a real small payment and a real refund, before launch.

fit.p: If people fill a basket and vanish at the payment step, something there is putting them off. A missing payment method, a scary redirect, an error nobody told you about. All fixable.
yes: Watching baskets get abandoned at the payment step
Missing a payment method your customers ask for
Typing orders into accounting software by hand
Haunted by an order that was paid for and never recorded
fit.no: you don't have a store yet. Payments come with the build on our [Shopify](/services/shopify-website-design/) and [WooCommerce](/services/woocommerce-website-design/) projects. Selling in Saudi Arabia? [Web design Riyadh](/services/web-design-riyadh/) covers what's different there.

items.p: A free call about what you sell, where, and on which platform. We recommend gateways and give a fixed quote.
You apply for the merchant accounts, since they're yours. We tell you what to ask for and handle the technical forms.
The integration is built in sandbox, with confirmations, refunds and failures all handled.
Real test payments and refunds, then switch-on. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: One gateway on Shopify is a small job. Several gateways, a carrier and an accounting link on a custom build is not. We scope it and quote a fixed price. Gateway fees are separate and go to the gateway. Building the whole store? See our [plans](/pricing/).

tools.note: Named because they can be connected, not because we're anyone's partner. Which ones suit you depends on your licence and your customers.

faq.q: Which payment gateway should I use?
faq.a: It depends on your business type, your volumes and whether you take international cards. We compare fees and payout times for your case and don't default to one.

faq.q: Can you add Tabby or Tamara to an existing store?
faq.a: Yes. Both connect to the major store platforms. You'll need a merchant account with them first, and we handle the technical side.
We use hosted payment fields and tokens, so card numbers never touch your server. That keeps your compliance work small. We're not a PCI auditor and won't claim to be.

faq.q: What if an integration breaks later?
faq.a: APIs change. A [maintenance plan](/services/website-maintenance/) covers checks and fixes, or we fix it as a one-off with a quote first.

cta.p: Tell us your platform and where your customers are. We'll tell you what to connect.
